questions.text: Which ownership and allocation model is characteristic of `Box<T>`?

answers.text: One owner, with the value stored on the heap
Multiple owners with an atomic counter
Runtime borrow checking
A channel between threads

questions.explanation: `Box<T>` owns a heap-allocated value. The pointer itself has a known size and frees the data when it is dropped.
